issue.body:
I'd like to talk about both the project naming and ownership.

* The naming is just super awkward. I liked the *literal* sense of "little star", and the nod towards Simon Willison's datasette, though the feminized "starlet" is an anachronistic phrase that I'm not at all comfortable with, and I don't think is appropriate in a project with so little gender representation. Given that the 1.0 release is in the works, now might be a good time to clean this up a little?
* I'd like some reconsideration of the project ownership model. Perhaps there's space for community ownership of Starlette & Uvicorn either under a FastAPI organisation, or back under Encode. I've outlined aspects that I'm unhappy about in the past, and would prefer not to have to reiterate them, though I can say that it wasn't appropriate for Marcello to push for a repo transfer by removing my PyPI ownership without consent, or to attempt to change the licensing without discussion. As the author and license holder of the project, I'd like to see this more appropriately resolved one way or another.

Regards,

   Kim
issue.title: Project naming & ownership.
